d: Dilli sthit bhajpa mukhyalay men dipavli milan samaroh ka aayojan kiya gaya, jismen pradhanmantri narendr modi samet kendr sarkar ke kaee mantri shamil hue. is mauke par pradhanmantri ne midiya jagat ke sath apne aatmiy lagav ka jikr kiya aur dipavli ki shubhkamnaen din. vahin, jharkhand men vishesh gahan punrikshan yani esaaaeeaar ke tahat chal rahe karyon ki mukhy nirvachan padadhikari ne samiksha ki. samiksha ke dauran bataya gaya ki no maiping ke 56 pratishat, lojikal diskripensi ke 80 pratishat aur any shreniyon ke 98 pratishat mamlon ki sunvaee puri kar li gaee hai. idhar, karmik,…
